scripts.deploy: rbw-env 'env/oci/celld-test.illuwa.click' -- sh -c 'docker compose --env-file /dev/null build deploy && docker compose --env-file /dev/null run --rm --no-deps deploy'
scripts.server:start: rbw-env 'env/oci/celld-test.illuwa.click' -- docker compose --env-file /dev/null up -d --wait --wait-timeout 180 app caddy
scripts.server:logs: rbw-env 'env/oci/celld-test.illuwa.click' -- docker compose --env-file /dev/null logs -f app caddy
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/client/.assetsignore', { force: true })"
